name: How do I set a realistic budget for an interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I set a realistic budget for an interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Setting a realistic budget involves careful planning. Start by clearly defining your renovation goals and prioritizing what's most important. Research average costs for similar projects in your area, keeping in mind that material choices (e.g., luxury vs. standard) significantly impact pricing. Obtain detailed quotes from contractors, ensuring they itemize labor, materials, and permits. Always include a contingency fund, typically 10-20% of the total budget, for unforeseen issues or desired upgrades. Be transparent with your contractor about your financial limits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define goals, research local costs, get detailed quotes, and include a 10-20% contingency fund to set a realistic renovation budget.
